name: Black Steel Gate
desc1: A vast cavern gapes hungrily here, its long stalactite teeth dripping
desc2: with dark water. At the southern end of the cave is a large black
desc3: steel gate, covered with wicked-looking barbed spikes. The gate is
desc4: housed in a stone archway that takes up the whole passageway to the
desc5: cavern beyond. On either side of the gate is a superbly carved statue.
desc6: Beyond the gate some sort of outpost or town can be seen.
